content_sections.heading: About the Division
content_sections.text: Hassanur Forest Division is part of the Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve in Erode District, Tamil Nadu. Its office is headed by the Deputy Director and District Forest Officer, Hassanur Forest Division, Hassanur. The JRF post is under the Comprehensive Human-Wildlife Conflict Mitigation Scheme and is open to eligible and motivated Indian candidates.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The applicant should preferably be a resident of Tamil Nadu. The notice calls the post purely contractual and temporary. Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 55% marks in Wildlife Science, Wildlife Biology, Forestry, Ecology, Environmental Science, Zoology, Life Sciences, or Allied Disciplines from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum 1 year experience in ArcGIS Software or related GIS applications. Proficiency in Tamil and English (written and spoken), described as essential to liaise with frontline staff and village communities. Prior hands-on field experience in tracking large mammals, camera-trap deployment, spatial analysis using GIS software (QGIS/ArcGIS), statistical modeling and report drafting. Basic typing skills in both Tamil and English. A valid two-wheeler driving license is advantageous. The applicant should not be above 35 years of age as on 01.11.2026. Relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates as per Tamil Nadu Government norms; the notice does not print the amount. The notice does not give a minimum age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be appointed on a contractual basis for an initial tenure of one year. The tenure is extendable based on project requirements and satisfactory performance. The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 25,000/- (Including HRA and Travel), so HRA and travel are part of this amount and are not paid on top of it.

content_sections.heading: Hassanur Forest Division Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Field monitoring of wildlife movements. Conflict vulnerability hotspot mapping. Assessing linear infrastructure and elephant-proof barriers (solar fences, trenches, railway barricades). Gathering camera-trap and spatial data. Coordinating with Anti-Depredation Squads and local community stakeholders across Hassanur, Thalavadi, Germalam and Jeeragahalli ranges, and any other tasks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hassanur Forest Division Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format from the official Erode District website, https://erode.nic.in . Complete the application form and attach the documents listed below. Email the application in PDF format to [email protected] . Write this subject line: 'Application for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) – Comprehensive Human-Wildlife Conflict Mitigation Scheme. Alternatively, submit a hard copy by post or in person to: Deputy Director & District Forest Officer, Hassanur Forest Division, Hassanur – 638 401, Erode District, Tamil Nadu. Make sure the application is received by 05:45 PM on 01.12.2026 (Tuesday). Duly completed application form. Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Self-attested copies of academic mark sheets/certificates. Proof of age. Photo identification (e.g., valid government ID card). Relevant publications/experience certificates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an in-person interview and technical assessment at the Hassanur Division Office. Selection will be strictly based on merit, academic records, field aptitude and guidelines issued by the Tamil Nadu Forest Department. The notice does not give the interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is purely contractual and temporary. Extension beyond the initial one-year tenure depends on project requirements and satisfactory performance. The last date is the date of receipt of applications, so the application must reach the office or the email address by 05:45 PM on 01.12.2026.
